integrity: Derived from the published quartic equation and explicit Hilbert–Burch tensor calculation, with reproducible Python checks. Finite fields corroborate but do not prove the all-characteristic theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the complete-four-vertex cut quartic. Generic transverse local geometry does not classify non-generic intersections. Comparable statements may be implicit in general squarefree monomial hypersurface literature; no independent audit has been performed.
title: The complete-four-vertex cut quartic has a reduced, 36-component Cohen–Macaulay singular scheme
